recommendations.item: Integrate Sentry (or equivalent) on frontend ErrorBoundary + backend global handler
recommendations.rationale: No production error aggregation today — console-only logging

recommendations.item: Add structured JSON logging (pino/winston) with requestId correlation
recommendations.rationale: Current logs are ad-hoc console prefixes — hard to alert on

recommendations.item: Add AbortSignal.timeout to Solana RPC and contract intel provider fetches
recommendations.rationale: Hung upstream calls can block scanner routes beyond client 15s timeout

recommendations.item: Alert on /health failure, 5xx rate > 1%, p95 scan latency > 12s
recommendations.rationale: Launch gate depends on live scanner reliability

recommendations.item: Wire provider failure counters (Birdeye, LunarCrush, Alchemy 429) to metrics dashboard
recommendations.rationale: Degraded intelligence should be visible before users report it
